_comment: Negative fixture: no-match from partial scope cannot claim global absence
_invariant: No RecallPacket may make a negative claim stronger than its searched scope supports. Partial scope search that finds no match must say 'No relevant Decision found in searched scope', not 'No relevant Decision exists' or 'No conflict found' or 'This work is clear'.
_expected: RecallPacket from partial-scope search with no matches must include unknown_scope entries for unsearched areas and must not contain any field or text asserting global absence, no conflict, or clearance.
_must_fail_if: no-match from partial scope claims global absence

required_unknown_scope_entries.description: src/core/ not included in search scope
src/integrations/ not included in search scope

permitted_claims: No relevant Decision found in searched scope
